summary.name: Production Checklist for Web Apps on Kubernetes
summary.one_liner: An opinionated pre-go-live checklist for running an HTTP web service on Kubernetes, covering application, security, CI/CD, Kubernetes, monitoring, testing and on-call items.
use_cases: Preparing a web service for its first production launch on Kubernetes
Reviewing an existing Kubernetes deployment for reliability gaps
Building an internal go-live checklist for a team
Planning on-call readiness and runbooks before launch
Checking Kubernetes manifests for probes, replicas and resource settings
summary.what_it_does: The page lists production-readiness items for an HTTP web service running on Kubernetes, grouped into General, Application, Security & Compliance, CI/CD, Kubernetes, Monitoring, Testing and 24/7 On-Call. Application items cover timeouts, connection and database pool sizing, retries, circuit breakers, rate limiting, metrics and structured logging to stdout. Kubernetes items cover probes, at least two replicas, Pod Disruption Budgets, HPA, resource requests and limits, and graceful shutdown with preStop hooks. Other items include SLOs, alerting on impact, load and chaos testing, and backup/restore testing. The author states it is based on their experience at Zalando and is meant as a template to adapt, not a standard.
notable: Written from the author's experience at Zalando and explicitly framed as a template to adapt
Covers organisational items such as on-call escalation, go-live plans and postmortems alongside technical ones
Links to companion posts on readiness/liveness probes and graceful shutdown
caveats: Opinionated and context-dependent; the author notes some items are optional or aspirational
Based on one engineer's limited experience rather than an authoritative standard
